title: Measures to Reduce Negative Impact on Intertidal Habitats Like Changi Beach due to Increased Human Traffic
what_it_is: Measures to Reduce Negative Impact on Intertidal Habitats Like Changi Beach due to Increased Human Traffic

sections.label: Beach visitors and marine wildlife protection
sections.summary: Visitor numbers at beaches and intertidal zones rose, marine biodiversity is in good condition, and outreach efforts have been stepped up since 2021.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Over the last two years, we have observed a general increase in the number of visitors to our beaches, including Changi Beach.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: There has also been an increase in visitors to the intertidal zone, especially during low tides.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Most of the visitors are families that come in small groups to explore the area, during public or school holidays.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We are committed to protecting the biodiversity of our coastal and marine ecosystems, including our intertidal zones.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Recent data indicates that our marine biodiversity is generally in good condition, with little change in the composition of the marine ecosystem within key habitats since 2016.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: For example, individuals who are found guilty of trapping or selling protected wildlife species without approval may be subject to a fine of up to $50,000, or to an imprisonment term of up to two years, or both.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Over the past five years, there have been no cases prosecuted for the poaching of marine wildlife under the Wildlife Act or its predecessor, the Wild Animals and Birds Act.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: Since 2021, with the increase in visitorship to these areas, we have also stepped up outreach efforts at various intertidal areas to raise public awareness on protecting marine wildlife.

sections.label: Managing intertidal visitor numbers
sections.summary: NParks will continue stepping up efforts and is discussing with partners ways to manage visitor numbers while keeping intertidal areas open for recreation.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: NParks will continue to step up these efforts.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for National Development (Mr Desmond Lee)
sentences.text: We are discussing with our partners, such as the marine conservation community, volunteers, businesses and the local community, on ways to manage the number of visitors at intertidal areas, in a way that supports nature conservation while keeping these spaces open for public recreation.
